props.text: Helping every child learn, grow and thrive

At Pebblewood we believe every child deserves a safe, warm and inspiring place where they can reach their full potential. Our play-based approach grows curiosity, creativity and confidence at every stage.
Since opening our doors we have partnered with families to create meaningful experiences that build friendships, life skills and a love of learning that lasts.
A history of care and early learning
We support children and families with a safe, joyful place where every child can learn, grow and build confidence.
We added infant care and an after-school club, with fresh play-based projects that grow creativity and curiosity.
We moved into a light-filled building with a garden, an art studio and room for more friends.
Pebblewood opened with one classroom and a big idea: childcare that feels like a second home.
Every child learns in a secure, caring place where their happiness, comfort and wellbeing come first.
Experienced teachers plan age-right activities that grow curiosity, confidence and communication.
From flexible hours to regular progress updates, we work alongside parents to make childcare simple.
